title.text: 4-Course Romantic Candlelit Dinner Cruise With Live Lounge Music

ratings.heading: Average of 3 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

tested.pop_html: I rode this cruise myself. The photos and video in the review are my own.What I checked: food, service, live music, seating and views. Full review ↓

pills.label: 19:00 · 2.5 h
pills.pop_html: Daily at 19:00 from late August to mid-April, 19:45 in summer. 2.5 hours on board.📍 Vigadó tér, Dock 7: Pest side, 2 minutes from Vörösmarty tér and the top of Váci utca. Legenda's covered dock has restrooms, so you can wait out of the rain.

pills.label: Pianist & singer
pills.pop_html: A pianist and singer play lounge music all evening. Quiet enough to talk: no loud folk show.

pills.label: No wheelchair access
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✕ not wheelchair accessible🎟️ Kids: €84 for ages 3-12 (3 courses); not for children under 3

pills.label: Welcome drink
pills.pop_html: 1 drink included: champagne, wine, beer, a soft drink or mineral water. Every other drink is paid on board.

pills.label: Romantic and quiet
pills.pop_html: Candlelit tables for two along the windows, a pianist and singer, no loud folk show. 10 of 70 recent guests booked it for a birthday, anniversary or engagement.

pills.label: Open top deck
pills.pop_html: The open top deck is free to use at any point of the evening. Seats can't be reserved, not even a window table: Legenda assigns the tables on board.

pills.label: 4 courses, 17 dishes
pills.pop_html: Chosen at your table: 6 starters, 2 soups, 6 mains (trout, pork, duck, beef, cauliflower steak or tuna) and 3 desserts. Children 3 to 12 get 3 courses.

pills.label: Diet notes
pills.pop_html: Gluten-free and lactose-free dishes are marked on the menu. No vegan menu, and it can't cater for food allergies.

best_for.pick_html: for a romantic 4-course candlelit dinner with live lounge music and the lit-up Parliament.
best_for.skip_html: on a tight budget, if you are vegan, or with food allergies: the listing can't cater for them.

items.a: Yes: 10 of 70 recent guests booked it for a birthday, anniversary or engagement.
55 of 70 recent guests talk about the food, nearly all positively. I chose from 17 dishes on my test dinner.
No. A pianist and singer play lounge music, quiet enough to talk. There is no loud folk show.

items.q: Can I reserve a window table?
items.a: No. Legenda doesn't take seat or table requests, whatever you book: tables are assigned on board.

items.q: Can I cancel or change the date?
items.a: Booked direct with Legenda, cancellation is free up to 72 hours before. You can also move your ticket to another day, if seats are free.

title.text: 4-Course Hungarian Dinner Cruise With Rajkó Folk Music & Dance

tested.pop_html: I rode this cruise myself. The photos and video in the review are my own.What I checked: food, the folk show, seating and views. Full review ↓

pills.label: 19:00 · 1.5 h
pills.pop_html: Departs at 19:00, back after 90 minutes. Arrive at least 15 minutes early.📍 Akadémia 2: Pest side, the second dock from the Chain Bridge towards Parliament. Look for the Gróf Széchenyi or Stadt Wien.

pills.label: Rajkó folk show
pills.pop_html: Musicians of the Rajkó Folk Orchestra play with a cimbalom, and folk dancers perform in costume. Guests say the band plays requests at the tables and the dancers come round for photos.

pills.label: Kids 6 and under free
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ⓘ not stated on the listing: ask the operator before you book🎟️ Kids: free for 6 and under (add them to the booking); child (7-12), student (13-25) and senior (66+) tickets

pills.label: Welcome drink
pills.pop_html: 1 welcome drink included. Other drinks are paid on board; a couple of guests suggest bringing change for tips.

pills.label: Lively folk evening
pills.pop_html: A show night more than a sightseeing cruise: dinner, live Rajkó music and costumed dancers. 34 of 61 recent guests mention the dancers, 34 the music.

pills.label: Deck for the views
pills.pop_html: Guests say you can step out on deck to watch the lit-up city quietly. Guests who arrived 30 minutes early got a window table without booking one.

pills.label: 3 set menus
pills.pop_html: Served at your table: dips to start, then Urban Classic (goulash soup, pork tenderloin), Paprika Mood (chicken paprikash) or Veggie Flow (vegetable soup, pasta marinara), and Somlói sponge cake. Some past dates served a buffet instead: 6 of 61 recent guests mention one.

pills.label: Historic ship
pills.pop_html: An evening cruise on a historic ship, the Gróf Széchenyi or Stadt Wien. One guest calls it a well-kept vintage boat.

best_for.pick_html: for a lively Hungarian evening with a 4-course dinner, Rajkó folk music and costumed dancers.
best_for.skip_html: if sightseeing is your priority: the show and the dinner take centre stage, and the views from the ship are limited.

items.a: 44 of 61 recent guests talk about the food, almost all positively. 2 found it lukewarm or a bit dry.
A show night. The band plays requests at the tables and the dancers come round for photos; you can step out on deck to watch the city.
The listing shows three set menus served at your table. 6 of 61 recent guests had a buffet on their date.
Yes. Children 6 and under go free but must be added to the booking. Families say kids got to dance with the dancers.
At least 15 minutes. Guests who came 30 minutes early got a window table without booking one.

title.text: Silverline 4-Course Dinner Cruises: No Show, Folk & Operetta or Piano Show

ratings.heading: Average of 3 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

tested.pop_html: I rode this cruise myself. The photos and video in the review are my own.What I checked: food, service, seating, the show and the views. Full review ↓

pills.label: 19:00 · 2 h
pills.pop_html: Departs at 19:00, timed to start around sunset; 2 hours. Boarding opens 45 minutes before; arrive at least 30 minutes early.📍 Dock 11, Elizabeth Bridge: Jane Haining rakpart on the Pest side, next to Elizabeth Bridge. The boat sails south to Lágymányosi Bridge, then north to Margaret Bridge.

pills.label: 3 show options
pills.pop_html: Dinner & Lights (no show, background music) from €77, or the Folk & Operetta Show with singers and folk dancers from €91. Same boat, same 4-course menu. Silverline also lists a Live Piano Show.

pills.label: No wheelchair access
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✕ no wheelchair access🎟️ Kids: infant tickets don't include dinner (order on board); alcohol only from 18; service dogs only

pills.label: Welcome drink
pills.pop_html: 1 welcome drink included: Prosecco on Dinner & Lights, champagne on the folk show. Other drinks are paid on board, and you can't bring your own. 2 of 31 recent guests wish more were included.

pills.label: Calm, sunset start
pills.pop_html: A quiet dinner with background music on Dinner & Lights, timed to start around sunset. 18 of 31 recent guests praise the staff, many naming their waiter.

pills.label: Window seat +€15
pills.pop_html: A window seat costs €15 more per person on Dinner & Lights, €25 on the Folk & Operetta show. Choose it when you book; one guest said the window table was worth it.

pills.label: 4-course menu
pills.pop_html: Panzanella with pear and burrata, then a choice of 2 soups, 4 mains (walnut cod, pork tenderloin, curry lamb chops or a vegetarian sweet potato boat) and 3 desserts. Same menu on every option.

pills.label: Veg, GF & LF
pills.pop_html: A vegetarian main is on the menu, and most dishes are made with gluten-free and/or lactose-free ingredients. No allergen-free kitchen; tell Silverline about special diets in advance.

best_for.pick_html: for a good-value 4-course dinner with no show or a folk and operetta show, on the same boat.
best_for.skip_html: if you want drinks included or a window table at no extra cost: only one welcome drink is included and window seats cost more.

items.a: Dinner & Lights (€77) for a quiet dinner and the views, or the Folk & Operetta Show (€91) for singers and folk dancers. Same boat, same menu.
Only the welcome drink. 2 of 31 recent guests wish more were included at this price.

items.q: Is the window seat worth it?
items.a: It costs €15 extra on Dinner & Lights. One recent guest said the window table was worth the money.

items.q: Can I cancel or change the date?
items.a: Yes, free up to 24 hours before departure when you book direct with Silverline. Within 24 hours there is no refund.
Boarding opens 45 minutes before the 19:00 departure. Arrive at least 30 minutes early.

title.text: Buffet Dinner Cruise With Live Music & Unlimited Drinks

ratings.heading: Average of 3 booking sites, weighted by number of reviews

pills.label: 19:30 · 2.5 h
pills.pop_html: Departs at 19:30 in November, 18:30 in December; about 2.5 hours. Arrive 20 to 30 minutes early with your QR voucher and ID.📍 Akadémia 3: Pest side by the Chain Bridge. Bring a passport or ID card with your QR voucher.

pills.label: Live music
pills.pop_html: Live music in the Grand Salon all evening; guests mention violin and saxophone. No sightseeing commentary, just an English-speaking host.

pills.label: Wheelchair OK
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✓ wheelchair-accessible boat🎟️ Kids: free under 4, full price for 4-17

pills.label: Unlimited drinks
pills.pop_html: Included all evening: cocktails, spirits, Prosecco, wine, beer, soft drinks and water, served to your table. 25 of 64 recent guests mention the unlimited drinks.

pills.label: All-inclusive evening
pills.pop_html: A seasonal buffet, unlimited drinks and live music, so nothing to pay on board. Guests say it works even in pouring rain.

pills.label: Rooftop after dinner
pills.pop_html: After dinner the rooftop deck opens, weather permitting. Tables and window seats can't be guaranteed.

pills.label: Seasonal buffet
pills.pop_html: Buffet stations by Executive Chef Viktor Moldován: starters, mains, sides, vegetarian dishes and desserts. The winter menu (26 Nov to 25 Dec 2026) includes bean goulash, duck breast, venison ragout and pike-perch.

pills.label: Diet notes
pills.pop_html: Vegetarian buffet options, and vegan dishes are marked on the menu. Tell the operator about gluten-free or other needs in advance.

best_for.pick_html: for a buffet dinner with unlimited cocktails, wine and Prosecco served at your table, plus live music.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a guaranteed window table: the listing says tables and window seats can't be promised.
